text: I'm a childminder, I've got a 2 year old boy here overnight because his parents are stuck abroad with a cancelled flight. His temperature has just come up as 39.8 and I'm honestly quite scared, I think that's really high? His eczema's gone really red and flaky on his arms and behind his knees and he won't stop scratching. No fits or shaking or jerking, I've been watching him the whole time. There's no rash apart from the eczema, and I did the glass test on a couple of red bits anyway and they faded, I think, it's hard to tell with the eczema. I've tried his parents but can't get through. Please tell me what I should do
